newsitem.title: USA: Electronic Clearing says machines cleared. [CORRECTED 03:02 GMT 27/2]
newsitem.headline: Electronic Clearing says machines cleared. [CORRECTED 03:02 GMT 27/2]

text.p: Electronic Clearing House Inc on Wednesday said its unit, Computer Based Controls Inc, has been notified by the U.S. Postal Service that its Electronic Money Order Dispenser meets department requirements.
Electronic Clearing House said an initial deployment of 175 "stand alone" units are scheduled to begin delivery to the postal service in April.
The company said it had initial commitments to ship 175 units to the Postal Service and that the Postal Service would later consider purchasing another 400.
(Corrects to clarify how many units were ordered by the Postal Service).
